 8:17 PM ET an hour ago Corregidora Stadium
 It is the home stadium of Querétaro, one of the most important stadiums in Liga MX. with a capacity of 35,000 spectators. It was inaugurated on February 5, 1985, and will host this great soccer match between Gallos Blancos and La Máquina. The stadium is expected to be nearly sold out, as this is one of the most exciting matches in Mexican soccer—undoubtedly a great stadium for a great soccer match.

 8:00 PM ET an hour ago Keys of match
 We expect Cruz Azul to come out swinging in this match, looking to take the lead with a much more powerful offense. Querétaro will have to play smart if it wants to defend effectively in this highly anticipated match. Here are the keys to this big Liga MX matchup.

 7:51 PM ET an hour ago Referee
 The head referee in charge of officiating the match will be Mexican referee Cesar Arturo Ramos. Drawing on his national and international experience, he will be tasked with ensuring the match runs smoothly—especially since we expect plenty of physical play, given that both teams always compete fiercely for the ball. We will undoubtedly have an experienced referee at the helm.

 7:21 PM ET 2 hours ago Absences
 Neither team has any injured or suspended players, so they’ll have a full roster and their best players available for this match—where they’ll need to bring their A-game if they want to come away with a win in this Week 14 match in Mexican soccer. Here are the players who will be out for tomorrow’s game.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:45 PM ET 2 hours ago Background
 The head-to-head record favors Cruz Azul, as the two teams have faced each other 14 times, with Cruz Azul winning 8 games, 3 draws,and only 3 wins for Querétaro. Therefore, the visitors will enter tomorrow’s match as favorites to secure the victory and the 3 points. Here’s a look at the head-to-head history leading up to this big game.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:45 PM ET 2 hours ago How is Cruz Azul doing?
 For its part, Cruz Azul is coming off a 2-1 victory over Pachuca—a match in which they dominated and secured a crucial win to remain among the top three teams in the tournament. Now, they’ll visit Gallos with the goal of wrapping up this doubleheader on a high note. Both teams head into this matchup, which promises to be intense, full of goals, and packed with excitement; without a doubt, we’re in for a great soccer match in Liga MX.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:45 PM ET 2 hours ago How do you get to Querétaro?
 Querétaro is coming off a 2-1 loss to San Luis, a game in which they failed to tie the match and lost important points, Now they’ll face Cruz Azul in a match that promises to be one of the best as Liga MX Matchday 14 comes to a close. They’ll look to take advantage of home-field advantage to get back on the winning track. That’s how the Gallos Blancos head into this big match at Estadio Corregidora.

 Welcome to our live coverage of the match between Querétaro and Cruz Azul , part of Matchday 14 of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura tournament! Estadio Corregidora will host this clash between two teams in need of points to improve their standing in the league table and keep their hopes of reaching the Liguilla alive.
 My name is Juan Carlos Vera, and I will be your host for this broadcast, bringing you all the action and the most important updates from the match. Follow along here for live scores, confirmed lineups, goals, match statistics, and the current league standings.
